# Generated outputs (do not edit by hand)

All paths below are **rebuilt** by `./run.sh` or `make paper-artifacts`.

| Directory | Contents |
|-----------|----------|
| [`../figures/methodology/`](../figures/methodology/) | Canonical plot files (developer IDs: `Fig1_decision_map`, `FigD1_*`, …) |
| [`../paper_artifacts/`](../paper_artifacts/) | Manuscript handoff: captions, tables, numbered figure copies, review memos |
| [`../data/research/`](../data/research/) | Study JSON/CSV from deep research modules |
| [`../data/audit/`](../data/audit/) | Run logs (`run_all_analyses_latest.json`) |
| [`../data/simulated/`](../data/simulated/) | Simulation DGP outputs |

**Source code** lives under `src/lod_guide/`; **runners** under `examples/` and `run.sh`.

See [`../docs/PROJECT_LAYOUT.md`](../docs/PROJECT_LAYOUT.md) for the full map.
